## Sources

## Description

A STEP writer fails when the output file path exceeds 150 characters because an internal buffer is fixed-size. On Windows long-path systems with deeply nested test directories this is common.

## Reproducer recipe

Open writer with `output_path = "C:\\very\\long\\nested\\ path\\..."` (>150 characters). Writer fails or truncates the file.

## Expected kernel behavior

writer accepts paths of arbitrary length up to OS limits; never use fixed-size buffers for paths.

## Notes

Provenance tier: writer-side — writer fails / truncates on long output path; runtime writer behavior.
